source_description:
feature=002-constitutional-enforcement-engine-lite

[feature summary]
Define feature 002-constitutional-enforcement-engine-lite: a technology-agnostic enforcement engine that validates all repositories, features and workflows against the project constitution and the Spec Kitty SDD process. The engine provides a modular core, rule modules, workflow validators, repository hygiene checks and adapters for multiple stacks, with an initial adapter for the Django Core-App. It must remain stack-independent and reusable across future products.

[goals and non-goals]
Goals:
- Deliver a general-purpose enforcement engine independent of Python/Django.
- Provide modular architecture: core engine, rule modules, validators, reporters and adapters.
- Implement module discovery, configuration loading and rule selection.
- Provide core checks: constitution MUST-rule matcher, spec/plan/tasks validator, workflow-state validator, required-files validator and basic repository hygiene.
- Add a lightweight Git/GitHub adapter including CLI + CI integration.
- Provide an initial adapter for the Django Core-App skeleton while keeping the engine fully stack-agnostic.
Non-goals:
- No advanced static analysis.
- No UI or dashboard.
- No auto-fixing; detection only.
- No domain-specific rule packs.

[key user stories]
- As a core architect, I need an engine that confirms every feature, file and workflow step complies with the constitution and SDD rules.
- As a developer, I want local constitutional checks before committing or opening a PR.
- As a reviewer, I want CI output showing which constitutional checks passed/failed.
- As a maintainer of other repos, I want to reuse this engine with project-specific adapters.

[constraints and assumptions]
- Constitution in context/ is the single source of truth for MUST-rules.
- SDD workflow from SPEC_KITTY_WORKFLOW.md governs allowed phases and required artefacts.
- Engine must support local configuration via constitution_engine.yaml.
- Directory layout required: core/, rules/, validators/, reporters/, workflow/, spec-kitty-integration/, modules/{python,js,yaml,docker,terraform}, adapters/{git,github-actions}.
- Must implement: module discovery, config loading, spec/plan/tasks validator, MUST-rule matcher, workflow-state validator, repo hygiene checks, minimal Git/GitHub adapter + CLI.
- First adapter validates the Django Core-App bootstrap but engine must stay stack-agnostic.
